source.title: 3x3x3 One-Handed Attempt was identified as misscramble
source.content:
DISCLAIMER: Since the resolution of this incident, the regulation [11i](https://www.worldcubeassociation.org/regulations/#11i) has been updated. The outcome of this incident wouldn't change, but how it should be handled is now explicitely stated in the regulations. 

A competitor broke the European Record in his fourth attempt the second round of 3x3x3 One-Handed. When trying to reconstruct the solve, it was discovered that the puzzle was not scrambled correctly (one move in the middle of the scramble was missing). The competitor was granted a provisional extra attempt at the competition.

The WRC decided to replace the original attempt with the extra attempt.

translation.title: 三阶单手还原被认定使用了错误打乱
translation.content:
说明：此事件处理后，规则 [11i](https://www.worldcubeassociation.org/regulations/#11i) 已更新。事件结果不会改变，但现在规则已明确规定处理方式。

一名选手在三阶单手第二轮第四次尝试中打破欧洲纪录。复盘时发现魔方打乱错误，漏掉了打乱中间的一步。比赛现场给予选手一次暂定的额外尝试。

WRC 决定以额外尝试替代原尝试。
